content.comment_body: Hello, how can I configure the [product_name] [article_no] to operate as either a master or slave on a network using [product_name]?
Hi, please refer to this discussion: [url] for an example that might help. Hope this is useful. Regards, [user_name]
I am unable to get the Network Output block to function. On the master device, I added the Network Output block and specified the slave IP. What is required on the slave side?

Hello, did you configure the slave device correctly? To set a [product_name] [article_no] as a slave: 1. Assign an IP address and switch to Slave mode. 2. Enter the Master’s IP address on the slave. Often, users mistakenly set both devices to the same IP address, which will not work. Hope this information is helpful.

I have set up the master and slave devices with individual IP addresses, and I can use the Network Output block by referencing the VB address. My issue is using the network output and input blocks with the IP option. Can someone clarify how to do this?
